research_consequence: Every minimizer candidate decomposes into a low survivor cylinder and a necessary residual phase-frontier ancestor, but the ancestor alone does not determine a valid lift.
scientific_boundary: This theorem does not prove recurring positive actual return penalties, phase-complexity divergence, exclusion of eventual center period two, or Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.

theorem.fiber_bound: Every nonempty one-level projection fiber contains between two and four outputs.
theorem.iterated_projection: For every 0<=L<k, x in O_(a,k) implies x>>(2L) in O_(a,k-L).
theorem.minimizer_coupling: A complexity-k phase output in a depth-L survivor cylinder has aligned high quotient in O_(a,k-L) whenever L<k.
theorem.one_level_projection: For every phase a in {p,u} and k>=2, x in O_(a,k) implies x>>2 in O_(a,k-1).

title: Phase-frontier projection tower and minimizer high ancestors
